title: The finite single-degree and native constant comparisons coincide
statement: For a commutative ring A and f:X -> Y, the hom of singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso (ModuleCat A) f at ordinaryFiniteConstant A Y followed by single of upperStarConstantSheafIso at ModuleCat.of A A equals the hom of leftDerivedUpperStarSingleConstantSheafIso at that same coefficient object [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows].

proof.text: Specialize nativeConstant_hom to the coefficient category ModuleCat A and its object ModuleCat.of A A. The specified constant sheaf is the constant sheaf at that object by definition.

proof_origin.place: The finite single-degree and native constant comparisons coincide in the first-coordinate constant-object normalization.

from.place: The constant-object unit normalization in the first triangle.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteConstantComparison_hom
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom.app
        (ordinaryFiniteConstant A Y) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map
        ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom.app
          (ModuleCat.of A A)) =
    (leftDerivedUpperStarSingleConstantSheafIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f
      (ModuleCat.of A A)).hom
